lines.en: label makotonew1:
scene makotopool1
Another day of school comes to an end and, like always (Or at least a fair portion of the time), I’m headed to my office to provide counseling to whoever happens to be in need today.
lines.zh: 又一个上学的日子结束了，而像往常一样（或者至少相当一部分时候），我正要去办公室，给今天碰巧需要帮助的人做心理咨询。

lines.en: : Oh, good. You’re still here.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。你还在。

lines.en: Or not.
lines.zh: 或者不是。

lines.en: scene makotopool2
: I need your help with something.
lines.zh: : 我需要你帮个忙。

lines.en: : Sorry, do I know you?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我认识你吗？

lines.en: scene makotopool3
: Please don’t pretend you don’t know me just because I am actually asking for your help for once.
lines.zh: : 别因为我难得真的开口求你帮忙，就假装不认识我。

lines.en: : Are you a new student here? If you’re looking for the staff room-
lines.zh: : 你是这儿的新生吗？如果你在找教员室——

lines.en: : It’s me. Makoto.
lines.zh: : 是我。Makoto。

lines.en: : No, Makoto wears glasses.
lines.zh: : 不，Makoto 戴眼镜。

lines.en: scene makotopool4
: You see me without glasses all the time!
lines.zh: : 你经常见我不戴眼镜的样子！

lines.en: : I have never seen you before in my life.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子从没见过你。

lines.en: scene makotopool5
: Fine. I guess I’ll just have to be the only one wearing a swimsuit after all.
lines.zh: : 行。看来我还是得当唯一一个穿泳装的人了。

lines.en: : Let me start by apologizing for not recognizing you.
lines.zh: : 我先为没认出你道歉。

lines.en: scene makotopool6
: That’s what I thought...
lines.zh: : 我就知道……

lines.en: : So, what’s this involving swimsuits? Are you joining the swim club or something?
lines.zh: : 那么，泳装是怎么回事？你要加入游泳社什么的吗？

lines.en: scene makotopool7
: Oh, please. I’m busy enough with student council. There’s no way I’d have time for another club on top of that.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。光学生会就够我忙的了。在那之上我哪还有时间再参加一个社团。

lines.en: : It’s just our class’s turn to clean the pool and, without your help, I’ll be doing it all on my own. Which I guess would be fine if not for the fact that I have work tonight.
lines.zh: : 只是轮到我们班打扫泳池，而没有你的帮忙，我就得一个人全干了。要不是我今晚还得上班，那倒也无所谓。

lines.en: : Remind me- where is it you work again?
lines.zh: : 提醒我一下——你又在哪儿上班来着？

lines.en: scene makotopool8
: Oh, you know. The same place you nearly assaulted me the other night. Does that ring a bell?
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是那天晚上你差点袭击我的同一个地方。有印象吗？

lines.en: : Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: scene makotopool9
: I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I’ve chalked it up to just one big misunderstanding and don’t hold it against you for getting sucked up into a moment I never should have enabled in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我已经把它归结为一场大大的误会，也不会因为你被卷进一个我本就不该纵容的时刻而怪你。

lines.en: : I don’t like that “but.”
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个「不过」。

lines.en: : {i}But{/i}, I still think it would be best if you would help me out with this tiny little chore. You know, since I’m so forgiving and kind and whatnot.
lines.zh: : {i}不过{/i}，我还是觉得你最好帮我这个小忙。你知道的，既然我这么宽容、这么善良什么的。

lines.en: : You know that all you had to say was the swimsuit thing, right? I’ve already made up my mind and am ready to go whenever.
lines.zh: : 你知道你只要说泳装那句就行了吧？我已经决定了，随时可以走。

lines.en: : I obviously don’t have anything to wear, though, so you’ll have to do all of the cleaning yourself.
lines.zh: : 可我显然没东西可穿，所以打扫全得你自己来。

lines.en: scene makotopool10
: Oh, please. You really think I wouldn’t be prepared for something like this? I have a spare swimsuit for you in the left drawer of the desk in your office.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。你真以为我不会为这种事做准备？我在你办公室那张桌子的左边抽屉里，给你放了一件备用的泳装。

lines.en: : Please don’t smuggle swimwear into my desk, Makoto. That’s not what I need an assistant for.
lines.zh: : 别把泳衣走私进我的桌子，Makoto。那不是我雇助理的原因。

lines.en: : It clearly is since you’ll be putting it on immediately and meeting me near the pool.
lines.zh: : 显然就是，因为你马上就会穿上它，然后到泳池边跟我碰头。

lines.en: : I don’t even know where the pool is. I’ve never been there before.
lines.zh: : 我连泳池在哪儿都不知道。我从没去过。

lines.en: : Well, I suggest you figure it out if you actually do want to see me in my swimsuit...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我建议你搞清楚——如果你真想看我穿泳装的话……

lines.en: scene makotopool11
: Which...I guess is an actual thing I’ve said to my teacher now.
lines.zh: : 这……我想这话我是真的对我老师说了。

lines.en: : Well, say no more. I’m on my way. But if this is just one big ploy to get me into a speedo, I’m going to have to give you detention.
lines.zh: : 好了，不用再说了。我这就去。不过如果这只是个大阴谋、想让我穿上紧身泳裤，我就得给你个留校察看。

lines.en: : I’m Makoto Miyamura. I’m immune to detention.
lines.zh: : 我是宫村 Makoto。我对留校察看免疫。

lines.en: scene black
: We’ll see about that...
lines.zh: : 这我们走着瞧……

lines.en: Makoto and I part ways as I pick up where I left off before she showed up and continue heading to my office.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我分头走，我接着她出现之前的事，继续往办公室去。

lines.en: Unfortunately for whoever is facing emotional turmoil today, I won’t have any time for counseling.
lines.zh: 对今天正经历情绪风波的那位来说不幸的是，我没时间做心理咨询了。

lines.en: Instead, I am going to have to pretend to clean a pool so as to not disappoint my very-easily-disappointed class representative.
lines.zh: 相反，我得假装打扫泳池，免得让我那位极其容易失望的班长失望。

lines.en: All I can really say at this point (Apart from how little I want to actually expend energy after class) is that...
lines.zh: 到这会儿我唯一能说的（除了我有多不想在放学后消耗体力之外）就是……

lines.en: Well, I hope her swimsuit is worth it.
lines.zh: 嗯，希望她的泳装值这个价。

lines.en: scene makotopool12
It is.
lines.zh: 值。

lines.en: : I see you were able to locate the pool after all. Congratulations, Sensei. There’s a brush and a bucket behind you.
lines.zh: : 看来你终究还是找到泳池了。恭喜，老师。你身后有把刷子和一只桶。

lines.en: : The pool itself is cleaned by professionals, so we just need to take care of the perimeter.
lines.zh: : 泳池本身有专业人员清理，所以我们只需要负责周边。

lines.en: : Can I have permission to say something mildly creepy right now?
lines.zh: : 我能申请现在说一句有点变态的话吗？

lines.en: scene makotopool13
: You’re actually asking for permission? That’s odd.
lines.zh: : 你居然会先申请？真稀奇。

lines.en: : I suppose I can humor you by allowing you to say whatever sort of perverted thing you are about to say to me. So please, go ahead before I change my mind.
lines.zh: : 我想我就配合你一次，允许你对我说任何你正要说的下流话。所以请吧，趁我还没改主意。

lines.en: : Sure.
: Makoto, you are ridiculously hot and I wish you would wear that swimsuit literally everywhere.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你简直辣得离谱，我真希望你字面意义上穿着那件泳装去任何地方。

lines.en: : It’s hard to tell with your uniform on, but your body is essentially flawless and you are making it very hard for me to not achieve an erection right now.
lines.zh: : 穿着校服的时候很难看出来，可你的身材基本完美，而现在你让我很难不勃起。

lines.en: : Are you done?
lines.zh: : 说完了吗？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 我想是的。

lines.en: scene makotopool14
: Good. That actually could have been a lot worse and I’m very proud of you for being able to mostly contain yourself.
lines.zh: : 好。那其实可以糟得多，而你能大体克制住自己，我真为你骄傲。

lines.en: : Though, I do wish you’d remember that I’m a bit of a protege to you and that you are putting our relationship in grave danger every time you stare at me like that.
lines.zh: : 不过，我真希望你能记住我是你的某种门生，而你每次那样盯着我看，都是在把我们这段关系置于极大的危险中。

lines.en: : Stop being so attractive and I’ll stop staring. It’s that easy.
lines.zh: : 别这么有吸引力，我就不盯着了。就这么简单。

lines.en: : Bucket. Now.
lines.zh: : 桶。现在。

lines.en: scene black
: You’re really bossy today, Makoto. I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 你今天真爱指使人，Makoto。我不喜欢。

lines.en: : The further out of line you get, the harder I have to push you back in. We’re already way behind schedule.
lines.zh: : 你越出格，我就得越用力把你推回去。我们已经落后进度很多了。

lines.en: I do as Makoto says and retrieve a bucket of soap she must have pre-positioned near the entryway as well as a brush to just...hold and pretend I’m actually using.
lines.zh: 我照 Makoto 说的做，提来一桶她大概是事先放在入口附近的肥皂水，外加一把刷子，就……拿着，装作我真的在用。

lines.en: Of course I’m not going to actually {i}clean,{/i} but as long as I can make her believe I am, I’m sure everything will work out okay.
lines.zh: 我当然不会真{i}打扫{/i}，不过只要能让她相信我在打扫，我确信一切都会顺利。

lines.en: scene makotopool15
: Okay. Break time.
lines.zh: : 好。休息时间。

lines.en: : It’s been thirty seconds.
lines.zh: : 才过了三十秒。

lines.en: : That’s it? I feel like we’ve been doing this for hours.
lines.zh: : 就三十秒？我感觉我们已经干了好几个小时了。

lines.en: : Your brush hasn’t even touched the tiles yet.
lines.zh: : 你的刷子连瓷砖都还没碰到。

lines.en: : Why were you assigned to do this on your own in the first place? There are nine other girls in the class. Couldn’t one of them have helped you instead of me?
lines.zh: : 为什么一开始会派你一个人干这个？班上有另外九个女生。她们其中一个不能来帮你，非得是我吗？

lines.en: : I wasn’t assigned to do this on my own. Yumi and Chika were supposed to help.
lines.zh: : 我不是被派来一个人干的。Yumi 和 Chika 本来应该帮忙。

lines.en: : Ah. Well, I guess there was never any chance for Yumi to actually contribute to something like this...but I’m surprised Chika didn’t show.
lines.zh: : 啊。好吧，我想 Yumi 本来就没什么可能真来帮这种忙……不过我挺意外 Chika 没来。

lines.en: : It very likely just slipped her mind. I’m sure she would have come if I reminded her.
lines.zh: : 大概就是她忘了。我要是提醒她，她肯定会来的。

lines.en: : Why didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不提醒？

lines.en: scene makotopool16
: Let’s just say I’m not the only person with prior obligations after school.
lines.zh: : 这么说吧——不是只有我一个人放学后有别的事。

lines.en: : Chika’s living situation doesn’t allow for a lot of extra time after school, so...consider this as me simply being a good samaritan.
lines.zh: : Chika 的家庭情况让她放学后没有多少多余时间，所以……就把这当成我在当一次好心的撒玛利亚人吧。

lines.en: if chikadorm15 == True:
: I didn’t realize you were also aware of Chika’s {i}situation.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道你也知道 Chika 的{i}情况{/i}。

lines.en: scene makotopool17
: Ahh. I take it you know as well, then. Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 啊。看来你也知道，那我为什么不意外呢。

lines.en: : Chika hasn’t directly told me what her situation is, but it’s pretty easy to figure out if you pay any amount of attention to her.
lines.zh: : Chika 没直接跟我说过她的处境，不过只要你稍微留意她一点，很容易就能看出来。

lines.en: : Always rushing home after school...being held back a whole year...forging signatures on permission slips...
lines.zh: : 放学后总是急着回家……被留了一整年……在许可单上伪造签名……

lines.en: : Anyone actually looking for an answer could easily find one. I just happened to be one of the few to look.
lines.zh: : 任何真想找答案的人都能轻易找到。我只是碰巧是少数几个去找的人之一。

lines.en: else:
: What’s wrong with her living situation?
lines.zh: : 她的家庭情况怎么了？

lines.en: scene makotopool17
: Why don’t you try and find out yourself? She seems to like this new version of you. I doubt she’d be opposed to opening up once you get to know her a little more.
lines.zh: : 你为什么不自己试着搞清楚？她似乎喜欢现在这个版本的你。我怀疑等你再了解她一点之后，她不会排斥敞开心扉。

lines.en: : I’m simply doing my part as the class representative and making everyone’s lives a little bit easier whenever I can.
lines.zh: : 我只是在尽我作为班长的本分，尽我所能让每个人的生活轻松一点。

lines.en: scene makotopool16
: Any reason for the sudden bout of silence, Sensei? And don’t pretend to be too focused on work when I know you haven’t even started yet.
lines.zh: : 怎么突然不说话了，老师？也别装得太专注于工作，我知道你还没开始呢。

lines.en: : You’re a really good person, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 你真是个好人，Makoto。

lines.en: scene makotopool18
: It’s easy to do good things for someone when you’re getting something in return. But it takes a special kind of person to do those things for nothing.
lines.zh: : 有回报的时候对人做好事很容易。可要什么都不图地做那些事，需要一种特别的人。

lines.en: : You’re not over here trying to leverage Chika’s position against her...and you haven’t even brought up disciplining Yumi for bailing on responsibilities you had to take on yourself.
lines.zh: : 你不是那种拿 Chika 的处境来要挟她的人……而且你也没提过要处分 Yumi 逃避责任、害你得自己扛。

lines.en: : Not to mention all of the stuff you do for me...
lines.zh: : 更别说你为我做的那些事……

lines.en: : You’re just a genuinely good person.
lines.zh: : 你就是个真正的好人。

lines.en: : Any reason for the sudden bout of silence, Makoto? And don’t pretend to be too focused on work when you haven’t scrubbed in almost ten seconds now.
lines.zh: : 怎么突然不说话了，Makoto？也别装得太专注于工作，你已经快十秒没擦了。

lines.en: scene makotopool19
: Sorry. That just took me by surprise...
lines.zh: : 抱歉。那只是让我有点意外……

lines.en: : It’s been a while since you’ve genuinely complimented me like that and...I think...my heart might have skipped a beat or two.
lines.zh: : 你已经很久没有真心这样夸过我了，而且……我想……我的心跳可能漏了一两拍。

lines.en: : Well, don’t let it skip too many more because I don’t have a license and can’t drive you to the hospital.
lines.zh: : 嗯，别让它漏太多，因为我没有驾照，没法开车送你去医院。

lines.en: scene makotopool20
: It just...feels really good to be recognized.
lines.zh: : 只是……被认可的感觉真的很好。

lines.en: : Sometimes, it feels like no one really notices me or...even thinks of how things would be {i}without{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 有时候，我感觉根本没人真的注意到我，或者……甚至没人想过{i}没有我{/i}会怎么样。

lines.en: : To a lot of the girls in our class, I’m just some roadblock between them and an exciting high school life.
lines.zh: : 对我们班很多女生来说，我只是挡在她们和精彩高中生活之间的一道路障。

lines.en: : And I’m sure that, in many ways, that’s completely  true.
lines.zh: : 而我确信，在很多方面，那完全是真的。

lines.en: : I know I can be a little anal when it comes to rules and regulations and stuff...
lines.zh: : 我知道我在规章制度什么的上面是有点吹毛求疵……

lines.en: : But all I really want is to make sure everything plays out smoothly...To make sure no one gets held back by their circumstances or themselves.
lines.zh: : 但我真正想要的只是确保一切顺利推进……确保没有人被自己的处境、或者被自己拖住。

lines.en: : And if that means shouldering a burden or two, that’s fine. I’m perfectly capable of handling small problems like that.
lines.zh: : 而如果那意味着要扛起一两个担子，那也没关系。那种小问题我完全应付得来。

lines.en: : Just don’t take on too many of them if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 只是如果可能的话，别一次扛太多。

lines.en: : That sort of thing can be dangerous.
lines.zh: : 那种事会很危险。

lines.en: scene makotopool21
: Thanks, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，老师。

lines.en: : That advice would have really resonated with me if you hadn’t been staring at my ass this entire time.
lines.zh: : 如果你没有全程盯着我的屁股看，这句建议本来会很打动我的。

lines.en: scene makotopool22
: I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: scene makotopool23
: You should really be more careful, you know. The pool might be in its own building, but we’re still technically on school grounds.
lines.zh: : 你真该小心点，你知道的。泳池也许在单独的楼里，可我们严格来说还在校园里。

lines.en: : Someone could show up any minute now.
lines.zh: : 随时可能有人来。

lines.en: : Good. That means they can clean instead of me.
lines.zh: : 好。那他们就能替我打扫了。

lines.en: scene makotopool24
: Forgive me if this question is on the tasteless side, but since when are you even this...attracted to me?
lines.zh: : 恕我这个问题有点不得体，不过你从什么时候开始对我这么……有感觉的？

lines.en: : In the beginning of the year, it seemed like you barely even acknowledged I was a girl.
lines.zh: : 学年刚开始的时候，你看起来连我是个女生都没怎么意识到。

lines.en: : Now, it feels like I can’t do {i}anything{/i} without having to dodge your gaze like it’s a car in a game of Frogger.
lines.zh: : 现在，我感觉我{i}做什么{/i}都躲不开你的目光，像在玩青蛙过河时躲车一样。

lines.en: : It might be safe to just assume it’s because I now directly associate you with pornography.
lines.zh: : 大概可以安全地假定，那是因为我现在直接把你跟色情制品联系起来了。

lines.en: scene makotopool25
: I think I started noticing this before you ever even found out where I work.
lines.zh: : 我想在你发现我在哪儿上班之前，我就开始注意到了。

lines.en: : It was like you just...woke up one day and you were suddenly interested in me as more than just an understudy.
lines.zh: : 就像你某天……醒来，突然就不只是把我当助手，而是对我有兴趣了。

lines.en: : Well...
: Maybe I was?
lines.zh: : 也许是吧？

lines.en: That {i}is{/i} what happened, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 事情{i}就是{/i}这样，不是吗？

lines.en: I have no idea what sort of person the previous iteration of me was, but if he wasn’t attracted to Makoto...was he even really a person at all?
lines.zh: 我不知道上一版的我是什么样的人，可如果他对 Makoto 没感觉……那他到底还算不算个人？

lines.en: scene makotopool26
: Well...as long as you can promise me you’re not just toying with my heart or something...I think I can be happy.
lines.zh: : 嗯……只要你向我保证你不是在玩弄我的感情什么的……我想我就能幸福。

lines.en: : If I found out that this was all just...some sort of game you were playing or...some sort of horrible joke...
lines.zh: : 如果我发现这一切只是……你在玩的某种游戏，或者……某种恶劣的玩笑……

lines.en: : That...
: That would really hurt...
lines.zh: : 那真的很伤人……

lines.en: : Why would I joke about something like this?
lines.zh: : 我为什么要拿这种事开玩笑？

lines.en: scene makotopool27
: Because you’re an adult...
lines.zh: : 因为你是成年人……

lines.en: : And behind all the sense and sagacity, I’m still just a vulnerable teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 而在所有这些理智和睿智背后，我依然只是个脆弱的青春期女孩。

lines.en: : I obviously look up to you...I...{i}admire{/i} you...
lines.zh: : 我显然仰望着你……我……{i}仰慕{/i}你……

lines.en: : I guess what I’m trying to get at is...
lines.zh: : 我想我想说的是……

lines.en: : It would be extremely easy for you to hurt me if you wanted to.
lines.zh: : 如果你愿意，要伤我易如反掌。

lines.en: : And I can’t figure out if you want to or not.
lines.zh: : 而我搞不清你到底想不想。

lines.en: : I don’t {i}want{/i} to hurt you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}想{/i}伤害你，Makoto。

lines.en: : I just can’t imagine a future where it doesn’t happen.
lines.zh: : 我只是想象不出一个它不会发生的未来。

lines.en: scene makotopool28
: But...what does that mean? I don’t understand.
lines.zh: : 可……那是什么意思？我不懂。

lines.en: : It means that this isn’t a joke and that I’m not just messing around with your vulnerable, teenage heart.
lines.zh: : 意思是这不是玩笑，我也不是在玩弄你那颗脆弱的青春期的心。

lines.en: : And that’s exactly what makes everything so much worse.
lines.zh: : 而正是这一点让一切都糟得多。

lines.en: : That alone isn’t {i}worse,{/i} Sensei. If you’re really not treating this as a game, I’m a lot more inclined to...
lines.zh: : 光是这一点{i}并不糟{/i}，老师。如果你真的没把这当游戏，我反而更愿意……

lines.en: : To what, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 更什么，Makoto？

lines.en: scene makotopool29
: Makoto-
lines.zh: : Makoto——

lines.en: : Uhh...uh-oh. I appear to have lost my balance.
lines.zh: : 呃……呃哦。我好像失去平衡了。

lines.en: s" Makoto, come-"
lines.zh: s" Makoto，快——"

lines.en: scene black
: Oh no. Losing my balance has resulted in me falling into the pool.
lines.zh: : 哦不。失去平衡导致我掉进了泳池。

lines.en: : If you think I’m going to clean the rest of this myself, you- wait. What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 如果你以为剩下的要我自己打扫，你——等等。你在干什么？

lines.en: : Oh no. I am now losing control over my hands. What is happening to me?
lines.zh: : 哦不。我的手正在失去控制。我这是怎么了？

lines.en: : Makoto, let go of my ankle.
lines.zh: : Makoto，松开我的脚踝。

lines.en: : I wish I could, Sensei. But I’m afraid it is too late.
lines.zh: : 我希望我能，老师。可恐怕已经太迟了。

lines.en: : Don’t even think about-
lines.zh: : 想都别想——

lines.en: Makoto tugs on my leg and sends me falling into the pool right on top of her.
lines.zh: Makoto 拽了一下我的腿，把我拽倒进泳池，正好压在她身上。

lines.en: We remain underwater for several seconds, attempting to pull apart before returning to the surface.
lines.zh: 我们在水下待了几秒，试图分开，然后才浮回水面。

lines.en: scene makotopool30
Our attempt at pulling apart doesn’t work as well as it could have.
lines.zh: 我们分开的努力没有取得本该有的效果。

lines.en: : Something...
lines.zh: : 有什么……

lines.en: : Something is poking me...
lines.zh: : 有什么东西在顶我……

lines.en: : Is that-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Yup.
: I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : I think...
lines.zh: : 我想……

lines.en: : I think we should have a talk soon...
lines.zh: : 我想我们该好好谈一次了……

lines.en: : I don’t really like talks.
lines.zh: : 我不是很喜欢「谈」。

lines.en: : I don’t think I do either, but...
lines.zh: : 我想我也不喜欢，不过……

lines.en: scene makotopool31
: I think you might like this one...
lines.zh: : 我想你会喜欢这一次……

lines.en: scene black
$ makotonew1 = True
$ makoto_love += 1
{i}Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump afterschoolevent
